insights.text: Did they nerf the pipe skip but still leave the Kuldra skip in? That's just dumb.

video.title: (Patched!)11 Min Full Kuldra Speedrun (Post-Patch 1.0.1) - Follow Along | RS Dragonwilds

insights.text: There's a faster skip after the Garou Thane. In the back corner there is a hole you can jump to and crouch through. A couple of jumps from here and you're at the abby demon. Cuts at least a minute off. You're also missing the skip after the abby demon that gets you direct over to the jump puzzle section past all the Thanes there. Saves another 2 minutes. Last skip is for the last puzzle, you can jump through a hole behind the pipes/fire section to get under the map and activate the final teleporter. Saves another 1-2 minutes. I think you can get close to 10 min runs with all those skips.
